about_the_game:
“This isn't a story about justice. It's a story about surviving the system.”

Step into the cold corridors of LUNA-V, a powerful tech company where ambition is currency and silence is survival. In Elara, a dark visual novel filled with manipulation, mystery, and moral choices, you play as Elara, a young recruit who quickly realizes that behind the polished walls of her new workplace lies a web of control, secrets, and death.

🌒 Key Features

🔍 Investigation & Deduction
Delve into the digital remnants of the deceased. Decode encrypted messages, analyze work logs, and uncover surveillance footage to piece together the hidden truth.

👥 A Web of Intertwined Relationships
Interact with five distinct colleagues—Lea the cold manipulator, Kay the quiet observer, Mira the conflicted HR. Every choice you make will ripple through your relationships and shape the narrative.

⚖️ Choices and Consequences
Expose the truth, blend into the system, or become the next puppet master. Your path defines whether Elara resists, conforms, or takes control.

📁 Multiple Endings & Branching Paths
Three major endings and various narrative branches reflect your moral stance and psychological evolution throughout the story.

🧠 Realism Meets Psychological Corporate Horror
Inspired by real-world workplace abuse, power dynamics, and information control, Elara invites you into a quiet yet brutal game of control and survival.

⚠️ Content Warning

This game contains mature themes including psychological manipulation, workplace bullying, death, and systemic oppression. Player discretion is advised.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of psychological abuse, workplace bullying, death, manipulation, and emotional breakdown. It includes scenes of blood, self-harm, and slow poisoning. Themes such as systemic inequality, gender bias, and social pressure are also explored. Viewer discretion is advised.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with Metal support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • Additional Notes: Mouse input recommended for best experience.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or discrete GPU with Metal support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Supports 3D audio (optional)
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for a fully immersive
